notes: %GINI_CALCULATION macro (weighted KS + Gini lift-table builder) is byte-identical to the source. The source driver read 'cur' from an external dataset not shipped with the repo (data cur; set cur; from an undefined table), so this bundle supplies a 15-row mock scored dataset (cb_achl_bad 0/1 flag + final_score) with the same column shape the macro expects; the macro call and its %let parameters are unmodified.
